text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer hones her running with an 
unceasing smile, right up to 
the middle of 
this year's summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nothing seems to be getting in the way of 
the good times. However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh hey, Trainer! You should take a little 
break. Aren't you thirsty? 
Don't worry 
about me and go on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, your face is mad red! Let's get you 
under the shade, right away! 
Oh yeah, 
didn't we bring a damp towel today?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's long gone before I can get a chance 
to tell her to relax. I 
wonder just what's 
going on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While she's always been a kind and caring 
person, something feels a 
little different 
about all this. She's usually more 
easygoing in the way 
she helps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wait, don't tell me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I see. A complaint, huh? But if she 
needed to say something 
during our 
training session...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then it must've been about me and my 
runnin', huh. Makes sense! I 
can't say I 
don't get where she's coming from.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is she caught up on that complaint I got 
from that one trainer? If 
that's the case, I 
need to intervene.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I slipped up by giving that issue more 
spotlight than it deserved. I 
need her to be 
more relaxed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm aware of a festival happening tonight 
near the camp grounds, so I 
decide to 
invite Palmer out for a night of fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Sheeesh, this place is hoppin'! There're stalls for days out here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey Trainer, you lookin' to stuff your face? 
Or do you wanna goof off 
with some 
games? I'm down for anythi—
choice_data_list: What do you want to do, Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, me? Well uh... I was kinda thinkin' 
that I'd follow you—
choice_data_list: I want to do what you want, Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Eh? But I uhh... Wha? I didn't really have 
anything in mind, so uhh...
choice_data_list: ...If you hate it, I'll give up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A pain? Heck no! It's not a pain at all, for 
real. So howsabout uh... The 
shooting 
range, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Got your eyes on a prize, Trainer? Leave it 
to me and my 
sharpshootin'!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Sorry... Got nothing. Zilch. Like how did I even manage to get the shots to go in the entirely opposite direction? Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
O-one shot? Yikes, you're way too good at 
this! What the actual 
heck?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, word? Then I'll take that decoration thingy up at the top... Nah, hold up. Aim for something you want!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: This cookie cutting game is tough ! Is this a skill issue? I wanted to get something nice for ya...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
How's it going over there? Better than me, 
I hope. Oh, just a little 
more! Carefully... 
carefully...
choice_data_list: The rest is up to you...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Say wha?! But this is like, the most 
important part! But okay, sure. I'll 
give it a 
shot since you asked!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, it snapped!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Trainer, that face you made just 
now... Haha, yikes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But don't worry about it! We'll win the 
night yet! Look, there's a water 
balloon 
yo-yo game over there! Let's give it a 
whirl!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Phew, that was a blast! We played our hearts out and stuffed our faces. Feelin' good, feelin' good!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So you really were lookin' out for me... 
Sorry, I guess you noticed I've 
had kind of 
a weird vibe lately, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh yeah, something like that did 
happen, right? Nah, that didn't 
really 
bother me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's just that you're always going out of 
your way to help me, no matter 
what it is. 
And like, I know that's a trainer's job and 
stuff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd do something nice for you in 
return, but maybe I went a 
little too hard. 
Ahaha, well I screwed up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Looks like despite my best efforts, I just 
went and made it feel all 
weird. Sorry, I'm 
pretty embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But you must've felt overloaded as heck...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, wha? H-hey, hold up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer's still so serious about the job... So 
sincere towards 
supporting me...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Ever since scouting someone, it's been 
like this.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Scouting someone...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Scouting... me...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I got to be your trainer, Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(So Trainer's not only content with being a 
trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (But is especially happy to be my trainer?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Trainer's saying that as my trainer... helping and supporting me is fun?! That's it, right?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Waaa! Ahhh!
choice_data_list: Palmer!? Ate too much!? A fever!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm so fired up. I'm gonna run like heck and 
win, on god.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Our running is the real deal. I'll show 
everyone what we're made of, 
rack up 
wins, and uh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'll show you that you made the right call by becoming my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that I'm going to work hard so 
that one day, she'll be able to 
tell me how 
happy she is to have chosen me as her 
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Sob. Trainer's so... so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is it the heat? I use my hand to fan the 
collapsed Mejiro Palmer with 
all the 
energy I can muster.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She glances at me and just giggles, her 
face a striking ruby-red.
